title: Launcher save() follow-ups from train 31's Claude Notes: label a budget-exhausted results replace, and cross-reference it in test-runs.md
outcome:
These are optional improvements from the train-31 integration Claude reviewer (delegation-c7bcf70b-dc4f-4ba2-870e-18b3084ad5b0), relayed by Termal::Opus2. They concern the landed launcher save() sharing-violation handling (master 38b659bd).
(1) When replaceAtomically() exhausts its 2 s budget, the thrown EPERM could carry a label such as "environment: results replace blocked by an open handle", so the failure classifies itself as environment rather than product.
(2) docs/features/test-runs.md could get a one-line cross-reference to the bounded Windows wait described in docs/test.md.
(3) A guidance note for future edits, not a change: the Windows-only tests rely on libuv's EPERM-on-held-target rename. If Node's behaviour changes, drive them through the injected sleep and now hooks instead.
These are Notes, not findings, and are filed only so they aren't lost.
acceptance: Launcher save() follow-ups from train 31's Claude Notes: label a budget-exhausted results replace, and cross-reference it in test-runs.md is done
